dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Houston Texans Prepare for Ravens Matchup Following Key Divisional Victory
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: Houston (4-6) enters Week 12 coming off a crucial home win against Indianapolis, leaning on a high-efficiency passing attack led by C.J. Stroud. Despite a #2 ranked defensive sack rate, the Texans must address a league-worst #32 ranking in punts inside the 20 before hosting the 4-7 Baltimore Ravens.
bullets: C.J. Stroud's performance against the Colts has analysts labeling him a top-5 AFC quarterback as he credits offseason weight room work for the arm strength displayed on his touchdown strike to Nico Collins [S12](https://www.houstontexans.com/news/cj-stroud-arm-strength-nico-collins-touchdown-colts), [S13](https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50541129/cj-stroud-top-5-afc-qb).

Head Coach DeMeco Ryans emphasized 'owning the home turf' during the Week 11 victory, where Will Anderson Jr. anchored a defense that currently ranks #2 in the NFL with a 9.5% sack rate [S9](https://www.houstontexans.com/news/texans-first-home-win-colts-demeco-ryans-fans), [S10](https://www.houstontexans.com/news/will-anderson-jr-texans-defense-colts-demeco-ryans-cj-stroud).

While Houston debuted its 'Rivalries' uniform combination in the win, the team continues to struggle on the ground, ranking #30 in yards per carry (3.58) and #25 in rushing EPA per game [S5](https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50554633/why-texans-run-game-power-wins), [S6](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50514892/nfl-week-11-uniforms).

Looking ahead to the November 29 matchup against Baltimore, Houston will be without star edge Danielle Hunter (hamstring) and wideout Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) as they face a Ravens team with a top-10 rushing attack [S8](https://www.espn.com/espn/betting/story/_/id/50501650/2026-nfl-week-11-schedule-odds-point-spreads-totals), [S14](https://www.houstontexans.com/news/houston-texans-vs-baltimore-ravens-how-to-watch-listen-live-stream).
